items.source: Uses of SockJsFrameType in org.springframework.web.socket.sockjs.frame

Support classes for creating SockJS frames including the encoding and decoding
of SockJS message frames.
items.translation: 支持创建 SockJS 帧的类，包括对 SockJS 消息帧的编码和解码。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
